instruction:
Subdivide Apartment Plate And Export Zone Areas

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Modify the provided floor plate and save the required outputs as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv; /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and /home/user/Desktop/result.csv is not empty.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 10 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 1 IfcSlab, 8 IfcDoor entities, 8 IfcOpeningElement entities, 8 IfcRelVoidsElement relationships, and 8 IfcRelFillsElement relationships.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcBuildingStorey is named exactly Level 1, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly A Living, A Bed, B Living, B Bed, C Living, C Bed, D Living, D Bed, South Corridor, and North Corridor, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
8. A Living, A Bed, B Living, C Living, C Bed, and D Living each have bounding-box dimensions 4.60 m by 4.60 m by 2.80 m; B Bed and D Bed each have 4.40 m by 4.60 m by 2.80 m; South Corridor has 19.40 m by 1.60 m by 2.80 m; and North Corridor has 19.40 m by 1.40 m by 2.80 m; each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. All spaces are spatially assigned to Level 1.
10. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly these headers in this order: SpaceName, Zone, Level, NetFloorArea.
11. /home/user/Desktop/result.csv has exactly 10 data rows, one row for each final space name.
12. The CSV rows for A Bed and A Living have Zone A, Level Level 1, and NetFloorArea 21.16; B Bed and B Living have Zone B, Level Level 1, and NetFloorArea 20.24 and 21.16 respectively; C Bed and C Living have Zone C, Level Level 1, and NetFloorArea 21.16 each; D Bed and D Living have Zone D, Level Level 1, and NetFloorArea 20.24 and 21.16 respectively; North Corridor and South Corridor have Zone Corridor, Level Level 1, and NetFloorArea 27.16 and 31.04 respectively, each numeric value with tolerance +/-0.02.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
